message: はいてなければ見られない

name: Ria
message: 「Ms. Ria's Open-Air Classroom~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is the second session.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aaah... Ria-chan is as cute as ever today...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yo! Weather Girl!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not 'Girl,' it's 'Lady'!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U~m, are we doing training today too?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Should we go for the real deal soon?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course no Demons show up at a time like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mere Demons are not enough. Rather, the king of Demons--yes, if the Demon King were to appear!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-The Demon King!?」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with your voice cracking like that? How pathetic.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ah, no...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me you got cold feet?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-No way that's true--」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Flinch*」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's how it was. To think Synn-kun was the Demon King... You were pretending to be our ally to betray us.」

name: Synn
message: 「No! I didn't mean to...」

name: Ria
message: 「We will protect the Human World. Even if it costs my life... I'll take you down with me, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though my only wish is just to eat beefsteak~~!?」
It'd be a disaster if something like that happened!!

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon King... huh. Let's see...」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Everyone's gained confidence and looking good. Keep it up, keep it up」
Phew... For a second there, I thought Senpai noticed.

name: Synn
message: 「Right, right! Whether it's Demons or nobles, it feels like we can take on anything!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. Don't get carried away so fast」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh」

name: Ria
message: 「If you want to know how much stronger you've gotten, real combat really is best, huh...」
Ria-senpai twirls her weapon around and around--I wonder if she used to be a baton twirler.
While I was staring in admiration, the tip of her weapon stopped, pointed right at me.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Wanna have a match with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Misa, did you call me?」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't call you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, sparring is the best way to gauge your true ability」
M―Me, fight Senpai? There's no way I could win―

name: Ria
message: 「If you're a boy too, Synn-kun... you'll accept, won't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If you put it like that, I can't exactly refuse」

name: Ria
message: 「Then the duel is on♪」
A serious one-on-one match, huh.

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. Here's a word of warning from the Great Sage Paqy」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you actually giving me advice?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's 'chanting speed' is off the charts. In exchange, though, her 'movements are a bit sluggish'」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's definitely gonna fight in a way that covers for that weakness」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「She'll throw off your rhythm, exploit the opening, and blast you with powerful Spirit Arts. You're guaranteed to get played around with by her moves」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really... Got it, thanks」

name: Paqy
message: 「So hold out as long as you can until we get a panty shot」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jibura!」
True enough, Senpai's skirt is as short as a school uniform's, so even a slightly intense movement would easily flip it up.
Wouldn't I end up seeing Ria-senpai's underwear if that happens...?!

name: Misa
message: 「The real spectacle will be seeing just how magnificently Onee-sama claims victory.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shiiin! Show her your pride as a man! Even if you get knocked down, never give up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if you lose, I'm sure you'll still gain something from it~」
Everyone believes in Senpai's victory without a shred of doubt.
They're right. If I keep thinking about weird things, I'll never win.

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, take your position.」
Former Student Council President VS Current Student Council President.
I can't let myself be intimidated just because she's my upperclassman. If I lose mentally, I won't stand a chance.
Having a chance to win comes down to how serious I'm willing to get.

name: Ria
message: 「Are you ready?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good to go.」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, here I come!」
